description: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Dawn (Vanilla Conquer, native)
long: Command & Conquer: Tiberian Dawn is the original entry in the seminal real-time strategy series, pitting the Global Defense Initiative against the terrorist Brotherhood of Nod in a war over the mysterious resource Tiberium. Players harvest resources, build bases, and command armies across full-motion-video briefed campaigns. This Vanilla Conquer port runs the game natively and retains its skirmish and network multiplayer.
